token-check.description: Pre-trade token safety check for Base, Solana, Robinhood Chain and major EVM chains. One call returns a verdict (OK / CAUTION / DANGER), a 0-100 risk score and ranked flags: honeypot, sell/buy tax, owner privileges, mint and freeze authority, creator honeypot history, holder concentration, LP lock, liquidity and pair age, plus the largest sell that stays under 1/2/5% price impact. Call before any swap or buy.

input.address: string (0x… EVM contract, or base58 Solana mint; Solana is auto-detected)
input.chain: string, optional: base | solana | robinhood | ethereum | bsc | arbitrum | optimism | polygon (default: base, or solana for a base58 mint)

output.market: {symbol, priceUsd, marketCapUsd, liquidityUsd, volume24hUsd, pairAgeHours, topPair}
output.creator: {address, honeypotHistory} (EVM)
output.exit: {impact1pct, impact2pct, impact5pct} max sell size in USD

batch-check.description: Safety-rank up to 10 tokens in one call. Returns each token's verdict, risk score and top flags, sorted safest first. Built for agents screening a watchlist, trending list or new launches before trading.

input.addresses: array of up to 10 token addresses, EVM or Solana (POST JSON), or comma-separated string (GET)
input.chain: string, optional: base | solana | robinhood | ethereum | bsc | arbitrum | optimism | polygon (one chain per call)

output.results: array of {address, symbol, verdict, riskScore, confidence, topFlags, liquidityUsd, maxSellUsdAt2pctImpact}

momentum.description: Short-term momentum read for any DEX-traded token: signal (STRONG_UP … STRONG_DOWN), -100..100 score, price change m5/h1/h6/h24, buy/sell flow ratio, volume acceleration, liquidity-to-market-cap and manipulation warnings. Use for entry and exit timing.

input.address: string (0x… EVM contract, or base58 Solana mint; Solana is auto-detected)
input.chain: string, optional: base | solana | robinhood | ethereum | bsc | arbitrum | optimism | polygon (default: base, or solana for a base58 mint)

twin-check.description: Copycat / twin token detector. Give a ticker and get every DEX-traded token using it, ranked by liquidity, volume, trades, age and socials, with the likely original and a confidence level. Optionally pass the address you were given to learn if it is the likely original or a likely copycat. Use before buying any token found by ticker, especially fresh launches on Robinhood Chain and Base.

input.chain: string, optional: base | solana | robinhood | ethereum | bsc | arbitrum | optimism | polygon (omit to search all chains)
input.address: string, optional: the contract address you want to verify

output.claim: {address, verdict: LIKELY_ORIGINAL | LEADING_BUT_CONTESTED | LIKELY_COPYCAT | NOT_FOUND_ON_DEX, rank} or null
output.candidates: array of {address, chain, name, liquidityUsd, volume24hUsd, trades24h, marketCapUsd, firstPairAt, pairs, hasSocials, originScore, url}

exit-check.description: Can I get out? Position-sizing and exit check for any DEX-traded token on Base, Solana, Robinhood Chain and major EVM chains. Give a token and a USD size and get estimated price impact, sell tax, total exit cost, expected proceeds, share of 24h volume, an exitability rating (EASY / OK / COSTLY / HARD / TRAPPED) and the largest single sell that stays under 1, 2 and 5% impact. Flags tokens whose contract blocks selling. Use before entering a position or when planning an exit.

input.address: string (0x… EVM contract, or base58 Solana mint; Solana is auto-detected)
input.usd: number, optional: position size in USD you would sell
input.chain: string, optional: base | solana | robinhood | ethereum | bsc | arbitrum | optimism | polygon

output.exitability: EASY | OK | COSTLY | HARD | TRAPPED | THIN | UNSIZED
output.position: {usd, estPriceImpactPct, sellTaxPct, estTotalExitCostPct, estProceedsUsd, shareOf24hVolumePct} or null
